Imports include name, brand, barcode, serving size, full nutrition, and image. Active duplicates are skipped; previously deleted items are restored with the latest data.
settings_import_from_nt_ui.mode_flat_desc: Each picked food becomes its own pantry item. Default behavior.
settings_import_from_nt_ui.mode_existing_desc: Attach all picked foods as branded variants of a generic you already have.
settings_import_from_nt_ui.mode_new_desc: Create a new generic (e.g. "Milk"), then drop all picked foods in as its variants.

settings_import_from_nt_ui.all_set: All set. Find them on the Pantry tab.

settings_server_connection_ui.push_all_message: Marks every recipe, pantry item, diary entry, and shopping list row as pending and sends it to the server. Use this once when first connecting a server to an existing local-mode library.
settings_server_connection_ui.log_out_message: Signs you out of the server account. Your phone stays connected to the same server. Sign back in next time you open the app.
settings_server_connection_ui.disconnect_message: Stops syncing with this server. Your phone keeps everything it has now; future changes stay on this device until you reconnect.
settings_server_connection_ui.local_sub: All data stays on this device. Connect to a CookTrace server below to sync.
settings_server_connection_ui.merge_sub: You have data on this phone. How should it be handled when connecting?

settings_server_connection_ui.download_desc: Replace this phone's data with everything from the server. Local data is discarded.
settings_server_connection_ui.merge_desc: Upload phone data AND pull server data. Nothing is lost, but duplicates are possible.

settings_user_management_ui.revoke_message: The link will stop working immediately. The recipient won't be able to use it after this.
settings_user_management_ui.invite_email_hint: Enter a valid email address, or clear the field to generate a shareable link.
settings_user_management_ui.strong_passwords_desc: Reject weak passwords (zxcvbn score below 3) on top of the standard 8-char + mixed-case + number + symbol rules. Affects new sign-ups, invites, and password changes. Existing passwords aren't re-checked.
settings_user_management_ui.session_desc: How long users stay signed in. Applies to new logins.

settings_appearance_ui.force_mobile_desc: Keep the mobile single-column layout even on wide screens.

settings_notifications_ui.device_desc: Use this browser or phone's notification system for reminders. Works alongside the push service below.
settings_notifications_ui.permission_desc: Most browsers require explicit permission before fired notifications appear.
settings_notifications_ui.service_desc: External delivery via Apprise, Gotify, or ntfy. Secrets stay on your server.
settings_notifications_ui.send_test_desc: Verifies the server can reach your service.
settings_notifications_ui.cook_day_desc: Planned cooks for today nudge you in the morning.
settings_notifications_ui.thaw_desc: Recipes planned for tomorrow ping the day before so the meat or dough has time to come up.
settings_notifications_ui.shopping_nudge_desc: A gentle reminder when unchecked shopping list items linger more than 3 days.
settings_notifications_ui.comment_replies_desc: When someone else comments on a recipe you own.
settings_notifications_ui.expiry_desc: One roll-up per day covering everything in your pantry expiring within the window below. Delivered through the same channels above (device and configured push service). No message when nothing's expiring.
settings_notifications_ui.warn_days_desc: The digest lists every item whose expiration date falls within the next N days. Past-expiry items always surface.
settings_notifications_ui.delivery_time_desc: The digest fires once per day at this time (server-local). Default 9:00 am so it lands before your first grocery run.
settings_notifications_ui.weekly_desc: Sundays at 8am: cooks logged, all-time favorite, what's planned, pantry and shopping snapshot. Requires SMTP and an email address on your account.
settings_notifications_ui.note_body: The push channels are wired and the test button proves delivery. Scheduled reminder firings (cook-day mornings, thaw alerts at 24h, shopping nudge after 3 days) attach in a follow-up. Toggle them on now and they'll start firing as soon as the scheduler is ready.

settings_diagnostics_ui.fold_flat: Open flat. Hinge at {start}-{end}px, so columns can line up with it.
settings_diagnostics_ui.fold_half_book: Half open, like a book. Crease at {start}-{end}px.
settings_diagnostics_ui.fold_half_laptop: Half open, like a laptop. Crease at {start}-{end}px.
settings_diagnostics_ui.fold_none: No hinge reported: not a foldable, or the system does not report one here.
settings_diagnostics_ui.mode_desc_native: Enables detailed app-internal logs (sync, settings, notifications) and writes them to a daily log file on disk so they survive crashes and reloads. Off by default; turn on while reproducing a bug, then export below.
settings_diagnostics_ui.mode_desc_web: Enables detailed app-internal logs (sync, settings, notifications) and verbose console output. Off by default; turn on while reproducing a bug, then export below.
settings_diagnostics_ui.logs_sheet_desc: Recent log lines (capped at 500 normally, 1000 in verbose mode). Header shows app version and platform so the recipient knows what they're looking at.
settings_diagnostics_ui.log_file_desc: Today's persisted log on disk (rotates daily, last 7 days kept). Better for long sessions or after a crash; the in-memory buffer above resets every reload.
settings_diagnostics_ui.crash_desc: The app captured an uncaught error. Share the report to help track it down, then dismiss it.

settings_food_sources_ui.username_hint: Needed to share products with Open Food Facts. An account is free.
settings_food_sources_ui.flashlight_desc: Turn on the rear-camera flashlight automatically when the scanner opens (web only; the native app uses the OS camera UI's own controls).

settings_regional_ui.measurement_desc: Imperial uses cups, oz, lb, °F. Metric uses ml, g, kg, °C.
settings_regional_ui.energy_desc: Most countries (US, UK, EU, Canada) use kilocalories; Australia and New Zealand use kilojoules. Independent from your measurement-system choice.

settings_about_ui.desc: Trace Every Recipe: From Pantry to Plate. CookTrace keeps your recipes, pantry, cook diary, and shopping list together in one place, with optional federation to NutriTrace for nutrition tracking. Your data lives on your server, not in the cloud.
settings_about_ui.feat_android: Native Android app with offline support, plus a PWA for any browser
settings_about_ui.feat_privacy: No tracking, no ads, no third-party analytics
settings_about_ui.disclaimer: CookTrace is not medical or dietary software. Recipe nutrition values are estimates based on user-entered data and may contain inaccuracies. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical or dietary advice. Use at your own discretion.

settings_cooking_ui.servings_desc: Used when a new recipe doesn't specify how many it makes.
settings_cooking_ui.auto_add_desc: When saving a recipe, automatically create Pantry rows for ingredient names that aren't linked yet. Off by default; turn on if you want your Pantry catalog to grow as you add or edit recipes. Manual links via the Pantry Link picker always work regardless.
settings_cooking_ui.show_shared_desc: When on, recipes shared with you (via a Kitchen or a direct grant) appear alongside your own on the Recipes tab. Each shared card keeps a "Shared by" badge plus a mint Kitchen chip so you can tell what's yours at a glance. Off by default; the Shared segment stays available either way.
settings_cooking_ui.grouping_desc: How the shopping list is grouped when it opens. By Aisle uses the per-item aisle (auto-populated from the linked pantry item's category); By Recipe keeps items with the recipe that added them; Flat is one uninterrupted list.
settings_cooking_ui.checked_desc: What happens to items after you check them off. Sink to Bottom keeps them visible so you can uncheck one checked by mistake; Hide removes them from view with a one-tap "Show Checked" toggle if you need them back.

settings_nutrition_ui.visibility_desc: Pick which nutrients show up in the Nutrition Facts box on every recipe. Hidden nutrients can still be entered in the editor but won't display.
settings_nutrition_ui.custom_desc: Track nutrients not covered by the built-in list (e.g. Omega-3). They show up wherever you enter nutrition and on the Nutrition Facts box.

settings_trace_ui.chef_hat_desc: A small flourish for CookTrace: the same Trace face, with a chef hat on top everywhere it appears.
settings_trace_ui.smart_log_desc: Hold the Trace button, say what you cooked, bought, or need, and let Trace add it for you. Examples: "I cooked the lasagna," "Add bananas to my shopping list," "I'm out of eggs," "Plan tacos for Friday." Tap-to-dictate (transcript only) still works when Smart Log is off.

manage_ui.gear_list_desc: Tools users list on recipes: pans, spatulas, mixers, parchment paper, sheet trays, anything they reach for. Renaming or deleting cascades through every recipe.

wizard_ui.prefs_desc: These shape how recipes display and what shopping units use.
